name: RAKSHITH RAGHAVENDRA
tagline: Most of my work starts with a question: can I actually build it?
leadNarrative: I build things that move from idea to system — through code, hardware, and machine learning. CSE–AI/ML @ RVCE. Author of Quantum Shadows ↗.
bio: Undergraduate engineering student at R V College of Engineering (RVCE), Bengaluru, specializing in Computer Science and Engineering (AI/ML). Focused on building real-world cyber-physical systems, static security analysis tools, computer vision pipelines, and embedded hardware.
